objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed item created, edited, released, distributed, revised, archived, translated, and reactivated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current document status such as editing, released, validation, or out of force.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Document version number or current version.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: Original language version of the document.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a new document and used to define templates, validity period, and archive duration.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after release for which validity is extended, set per document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period after archiving after which documents are physically deleted, set per document type.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template selectable when creating a new document object for a document type.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document, released with it, versioned, and archived with it.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary information added to a document and released or published directly through document properties.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for an existing document and managed in the document cockpit without affecting the document content or version history until scheduled.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document when validity is close to expiring and processed by workflow.

objs.name: aks_request
objs.description: Request created to declare a released document out of force and archive it.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person participating in creation, editing, review, release, distribution acknowledgement, translation, or administration.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group assigned authorizations, distribution, reader access, archive access, or business administration rights.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: Document-specific list of assigned users and user groups for e-mail distribution, acknowledgement, and dashboard assignment.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type or template.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific document metadata in document properties.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Edit the document content using the editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert the saved document to PDF and display the current version on the web.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add additional information to a document.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an attachment to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an existing attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark or archive an attachment with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Start the three-step release process for a document after creation, metadata maintenance, content maintenance, and document control definition.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs the creator step of the release workflow.

evts.name: complete_review
evts.description: Reviewer completes the review task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: complete_release
evts.description: Releaser completes the release task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: reject_workflow
evts.description: Reject a review or release task, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Finally release the document after positive workflow completion.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the released document so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_revision_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a valid released document is revised or when relevant changes require a new version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents editing of an assigned change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the valid-until date.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity and update the document valid-until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process and delete the request when a revised version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_aks_request
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare the document out of force, keep the AKS request for documentation, and revoke rights except archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the document to reactivate.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Confirm reactivation, creating a new document version and restoring metadata, properties, authorizations, distribution, and archived attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain the distribution list for a document with assigned users and user groups.

evts.name: notify_by_email
evts.description: Notify directly assigned users and users of assigned user groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request acknowledgement by e-mail and workflow upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement in a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Check and release the translated language version with workflow support.

o2o.description: A document is created with a selected document type.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
Attachments are associated with a main document.
Additional information can be added to a document.
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document.
A validity extension request is linked to the document to be checked.

A distribution list is maintained per document.

User groups can be assigned to the distribution list.
Users can be assigned to user groups by technical administration.
Users can be maintained as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, or reader for a document.
User groups can be assigned to documents for reader access, authorization, distribution, or archive access.
